draftGone: That unsaved spreadsheet is no longer available
draftUnreadable: Could not read the unsaved spreadsheet
nameTaken: A file with that name already exists
ownerRenames: This shared workbook is its owner’s file: only its owner can rename it
restoreChanged: The spreadsheet changed while preparing to restore. Your edits are intact; try restoring again.
sharedFile: This spreadsheet is shared for editing together, and the shared workbook could not be reached: it writes this file, and would write over changes saved here. Open the spreadsheet again once connected, or use File > Save a copy to keep your changes
signInToSave: Sign in to Puter to save this spreadsheet
status.movedOrDeleted: This file was moved or deleted
status.notChecked: This file could not be checked for changes made elsewhere
viewOnly: You can view this spreadsheet, but not change it. Use File > Save a copy to keep your changes
waitingToSend: Your changes are waiting to be sent. They are kept on this device until the connection returns.
